# Simulation, analysis, and visualization

- Before changing behavior, read the task's wiki topic, native protocol, model
  contract/docstrings, and relevant tests. Link any changed scientific meaning.
- Preserve declared observations, state/RNG snapshots, and matched intervention
  semantics. An unmatched counterfactual cannot support a matched-comparison claim.
- Prefer existing engines and plotting components with thin adapters. A reusable
  interface needs evidence from an actual consumer, not just abstraction.
- Separate full-run summaries from online information at the displayed timestep.
  Label supplied targets and exploratory candidate interpretations visibly.
- Keep mechanism, capability, candidate goal, and goal-relative competence
  distinct in code contracts and labels. Preserve the declared specimen origin,
  analyst access, and research purpose; a white-box implementation does not make
  an inference a discovery.
- Keep code-local meaning in docstrings/contracts; wiki synthesis links to it.
  Update operating instructions only for behavior verified in the named checkout.
